about: Configs that check.sh passes to try-config.sh on a build of reference/: `exit` is the exit status it must return and `output_contains` a text it must print. With `certify_traces` the config must also get a PASS certificate from that many traces.

cases.name: every-field
cases.covers: token_account, accounts, stubs, init.caller, gas_tgas, deposit, setup.receiver, may_fail, funder, track, token_near, timestamp_ns, transfer_memos, resolve_method

cases.name: setup-call-fails
cases.covers: a failing setup call without may_fail stops the set-up
